name: agent-monitor
description: Subagent monitor: a live band above the prompt for running agents, and /sub: this session's subagent history with alerts (file conflicts, stalls, tier mismatches, denied calls), a detail page per agent (select a row, Enter), a cost estimate, and an in-panel settings page (/sub set), in a band above the prompt or a side pane.

language.title: Language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the locale

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Only run in this directory and below (absolute path); empty = everywhere

stallMinutes.title: Stall threshold (minutes)
stallMinutes.description: A running subagent with no turn step or tool call for this long is flagged ~ (amber at the threshold, red at twice it)

autoBand.title: Live rows above the prompt
autoBand.description: Show one row per running subagent above the prompt

alertsBlock.title: Alerts block
alertsBlock.description: Show the alert sentences (conflict, stall, tier, denied) between the history header and the table

toasts.title: Toasts
toasts.description: Toast once per agent when a conflict or a stall is first seen

defaultPlacement.title: Default /sub placement
defaultPlacement.description: Where /sub opens the panel: last = wherever it was last opened (/sub top and /sub right are remembered across sessions); right or top = that place at every session start (/sub top|right then moves it for this session only)

colTier.title: Column: Tier
colTier.description: Show the Tier column (model.effort) in the history table

colEdits.title: Column: Edits
colEdits.description: Show the Edits column (files the agent edited) in the history table

colRounds.title: Column: Rounds
colRounds.description: Show the Rounds column in the history table

colTokens.title: Column: Tokens
colTokens.description: Show the Tokens column in the history table

colTime.title: Column: Time
colTime.description: Show the Time column in the history table

prices.title: Model prices (USD per million tokens)
prices.description: Compact JSON keyed by model family: {"sonnet":[input,cacheWrite5m,cacheRead,output],...}. Families: sonnet (5, 5.5), opus (5.5), haiku (4.5), fable (5.1). Defaults are Anthropic API list prices; a family left out keeps its default, bad JSON falls back to the defaults.

colAlerts.title: Column: Alerts
colAlerts.description: Show the Alerts glyph column in the history table and at the end of the live rows
